core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mulham is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Inspired, one given inspiration”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mulham corresponds to the Arabic form مُلْهَم (Arabic root ل ه م (l-h-m); مُلْهَم (Mulham)). Its core sense is mulham; inspired, one given inspiration. Mulham is Arabic مُلْهَم (Mulham) 'inspired, one given inspiration', from the root ل ه م (l-h-m). The source gloss 'Soldier, Warrior' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
